messages:
maria: Heads up — canary for prompt-router-v3 is showing a spike in 5xx when routing to the new endpoint /v3/generate. Deploybot reported errors.
deploy-bot: deploybot: canary rollout 2026-06-02T03:12Z -> prompt-router-v3. Canary progress: 60% -> error rate increasing. https://deploys.redwood/xyz
oncall-bot: pagerduty: page triggered for svc:prompt-router - INC-12345
raj: Oncall taking this. Which flag gates the v3 route? Is it 'prompt_route_experimental_v3'?
maria: Yes. Traffic split via that flag; canary set to 60% -> v3. Logs show repeated upstream 503s and kv cache eviction traces.
raj: Preparing emergency kill-switch. Running ffctl to flip to stable.
raj: ```
# flip experimental prompt route off in prod
ffctl set prompt_route_experimental_v3 off --env prod --reason "canary 5xx spike"
# audit curl
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  https://internal-api.redwood/flags/prompt_route_experimental_v3/toggle \
  -d '{"on":false}'
```
deploy-bot: deploybot: flag change accepted by ff-service. New traffic split -> 100% stable-route. Canary aborted.
maria: Observed metrics: 5xx rate fell from 3.2% -> 0.4% within 45s of flip. Throttle spike subsiding. Affected customers (sampling): acme-inc, brighthealth, sampleapp-ops.
emily: @raj I'm taking over oncall watch. Raj please add the exact command and timeline to the incident ticket so we can close PD.
raj: Added timeline + command to INC-12345. Also initiated a temporary proxy swap for any in-flight connections (v3 -> stable).
sre_lead: Good containment. Need sample traces + failing request ids for postmortem. @maria collect and store in /incidents/INC-12345/artifacts. Retain for 14d.
maria: Sample logs (sanitized):
```
2026-06-02T03:13:01Z prompt-router-v3 instance-7 ERROR upstream: 503 ServiceUnavailable kv_cache_eviction id=req_8a3f
2026-06-02T03:13:05Z prompt-router-v3 instance-9 ERROR upstream: 503 ModelTimeout id=req_8a41
2026-06-02T03:13:14Z prompt-router-v3 instance-7 WARN kv_cache pressure high count=8200
```
ops-bot: opsbot: runbook 'ff-emergency-toggle' executed by raj at 2026-06-02T03:14:12Z. Notifications sent to owners.
emily: Pager closed, metrics stable for 10m. I'll keep a 30m watch and then transition to postmortem + customer impact notes. @sre_lead please triage backend model-serving KV behavior.
sre_lead: Acknowledge. Opening internal ticket to debug kv eviction and kernel mismatch. Recommend adding stronger circuit breaker and health-check gating to the canary rollout path.
maria: Notifying Customer Success for outreach to affected customers. Draft message ready, will share in the incident ticket.
emily: Thanks team. Incident state: mitigated (feature flag flip + proxy swap). Postmortem assigned, follow-up RFC for rollout safeguards. :white_check_mark:
